1.

The present petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking quashment of the entire criminal proceedings arising out of FIR No. 70/2021 dated 16.03.2021 registered at Police Station - Outpost City Kotwali, Bilaspur for the offence punishable under Section 498A, 34, 342 of the IPC and Criminal Case No. 2611/2021 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class District-Bilaspur on account of amicable settlement arrived at between the parties.

2. Brief facts as reflected from the record are that petitioner No. 1 is Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:5445 the mother-in-law of respondent No. 5, petitioner No. 2 is the brother-in-law of Shushila Vishwakarma vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41966716/
1 respondent No. 5.

sentences.text: Respondent No. 5 filed complaint against the petitioners alleging demand of dowry against them.
On the basis of complaint, offence under Sections 498A, 34, 342 of the IPC has been registered against the petitioners.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that the petitioners and respondent No. 5 have already settled the dispute and they are living together peacefully without any hindrance, therefore,
the entire criminal proceedings against the petitioners initiated in connection with the FIR No.
70/2021 registered at Police Station - Outpost City Kotwali, Bilaspur may kindly be quashed.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

6. Pursuant to the direction given by this Court on 07.02.2024, the petitioners and respondent No. 5 have appeared before this Court and have recorded their statement before the Additional Registrar (Judicial) of this Court.

Respondent No. 5 in unequivocal terms has stated that she does not want to continue with the criminal proceedings against the petitioners initiated in connection with the FIR No. 70/2021 registered at Police Station - Outpost City Kotwali, Bilaspur and want to close the Criminal Case No. 2611/2021 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Bilaspur on account of settlement.
She has stated that she has voluntarily deposed that statement, it has been executed without fear, pressure or undue influence from the petitioner.

7. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the fact that the parties have amicably settled dispute between them and they do not want to continue with the criminal case, this court is of the considered opinion that there is sufficient material for this Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:5445 court to form an opinion that the criminal proceeding initiated against the petitioners can be quashed.

8. Accordingly, criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioners in connection with the FIR No.
70/2021 registered at Police Station - Outpost City Kotwali, Bilaspur and the Criminal Case No.
2611/2021 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Bilaspur are quashed in the interest of justice.

entities.text: Police Station - Outpost City Kotwali, Bilaspur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 9. In view of the above, the present petition is allowed.
No order as to costs.
10. Copy of this order be sent to the concerned Judicial Magistrate and the police station for necessary compliance and closure of the proceedings.
